group_variants.description:
If filtering by `root_product_ids` and `group_variants` is true, one aggregated level will be returned
for each variant family at each outlet.

include_composites.description: Include composite products in the response.

include_inactive.description: Include inactive products in the response.

location_ids.description: Optional outlet IDs to filter response by.

offset.description: How many inventory levels to skip.

product_ids.description: Optional product IDs to filter response by. Mutually exclusive with `root_product_ids`. When omitted, returns inventory levels for all products.

root_product_ids.description: Optional root product IDs to filter response by. Mutually exclusive with `product_ids`. When omitted, returns inventory levels for all products.

size.description: How many inventory levels to return.

sort_direction.description: Whether to sort the response ascending or descending.

sort_type.description: Which response field to sort by.

supplier_ids.description: Optional supplier IDs to filter response by.

to_be_procured_only.description: Only include inventory with a positive quantity to procure.
